findings.issue: The initial population identity needed explicit integrability, and the orthogonality path argument needed uniform overlap rather than pointwise positivity alone.
findings.resolution: Canonical section4 assumes integrable potential outcomes, qualifies expected-score identities by absolute integrability with a sufficient clipped-propensity condition, and imposes a common positive overlap bound along all sufficiently small bounded perturbations before differentiating the exact remainder.
findings.scope: Original model/proof assumptions clarified; all finite cases, exact exercises, answers and numerical checker calculations unchanged.
findings.status: resolved in canonical promotion; separate peer assessment pending
